responsibility: Implementation of the `brig_function` class, which owns the per-function translation state and many BRIG-specific code-generation services. It manages labels, register-backed temporary declarations, argument and kernarg layout tables, work-item ID variables, group/private segment bookkeeping, builtin lookup and expansion decisions, vector pack/unpack helpers, statement insertion, call/barrier analysis state, kernel finishing, launcher/metadata emission support, and opcode-to-tree-code mapping used by the instruction handlers.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line implementation of brig_function’s stateful translation services—such as label creation, kernel argument layout, builtin/opcode mapping, temporary generation, and basic-block tracking—whereas brig-function.h primarily defines the class interface and stored per-function state.
